title: Creator Analytics Export Freshness
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:ops source_name=* source_event_epoch=* export_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((export_epoch-source_event_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by source_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures analytics export lag by data source for creator analytics feeds.
value: Lag tracking shows which data source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside creator analytics feeds.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `analytics export lag` on `music:ops` events and aggregate them by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of data source with average and worst analytics export lag.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how long things take for each data source so you can see where creator analytics feeds slows down.
